chinglish: With the development of society, more and more people realize the importance of...
category: C8 万能套话
issue: 不传递题目信息，阅卷疲劳，被判"套模板"降档
native: Against the backdrop of rapid urbanization, an increasing number of residents have come to recognize...
safe: In recent years, people have increasingly realized that...

chinglish: More and more people are choosing to live in cities.
category: C8 + C1 冗余
source: Cambridge Dictionary "more and more" 用法标注；IELTS Writing Samples (writing9.com) 高频例句归纳
issue: "more and more" 偏口语，正式写作中重复感强
native: A growing number of people are opting for urban living.
safe: An increasing number of people choose to live in cities.

chinglish: The price of housing is very expensive.
category: C4 逐字直译 + C5 搭配错误
source: 搜狐/领思研学 2026-09-10 第5条；《国际安全研究》期刊例文：price 只能与 high/low 搭配；教师培训资料 2019-06
issue: expensive 修饰物品，不修饰 price；price 应用 high/low
native: Housing prices have surged dramatically.
safe: The price of housing is very high.

chinglish: I am impossible to finish the task on time.
category: C6 主表不匹配
source: 跨考教育/研招网 2014-05-15 原文例句
issue: impossible 描述事物，不描述人；主语应为 it 或任务本身
native: It would be impossible for me to complete this on schedule.
safe: It is impossible for me to finish the task on time.

chinglish: A person's ability can solve this problem.
category: C6 主谓不匹配
source: 跨考教育/研招网 2014-05-15 原文例句
issue: ability 不能 solve，人才能 solve；抽象主语与动作不匹配
native: Individuals with the right skill set can address this issue.
safe: A single person is unable to solve these problems.

chinglish: We must make a decision to take measures to improve the situation.
category: C2 名词化（双重）
source: Pinkham (2000) Ch.2；Saint Mary's College Pressbooks "Be Concise" 转换表: make a decision→decide
issue: make a decision = decide；take measures = act；名词化使句子臃肿无力
native: We must act now to improve the situation.
safe: We must decide to take action to improve the situation.

chinglish: It is necessary to take into consideration the factors of...
category: C2 名词化
source: OpenExamPrep Sentence Clarity 2026-08: take into consideration→consider；Williams Style Ch.9
issue: take into consideration 比 consider 多 3 个词，语义无增益
native: We must also consider the underlying factors.
safe: We should take these factors into consideration.（安全版保留常用搭配，避免冒险）

chinglish: Education plays a very important role in the modern society.
category: C1 冗余 + C8 套话
source: 豆丁网英语作文常用句型 2014；学科网高考短语清单 2026-01（"play an important role" 为高频模板句）
issue: "very" 空洞；"the modern society" 中 the 多余（society 泛指时不加 the）；句式烂大街
native: Education has become indispensable in today's knowledge economy.
safe: Education plays an important role in modern society.

chinglish: There is a young man is asking the barber to cut his hair.
category: C7 句式糅杂 / 双谓语
source: 跨考教育/研招网 2014-05-15 原文例句类型
issue: There is...is asking 双谓语无连词，语法硬伤
native: A young customer is asking the barber for a specific style.
safe: There is a young man asking the barber to cut his hair.

chinglish: Students study very diligent to pass the exam.
category: C9 词性错误
source: 跨考教育/研招网 2014-05-15 原文例句: "study very diligent"→diligently/hard
issue: diligent 是形容词，不能修饰动词 study；应用副词 diligently 或 hard
native: Students study diligently to prepare for their exams.
safe: Students study very hard to pass the exam.

chinglish: The picture vividly shows that...
category: C9 词性错误（vivid vs vividly）
source: 中国教育在线 2016-10-12: "vivid 是形容词词性，不能去修饰动词 show"
issue: 修饰动词 shows 应用副词 vividly；原形 vivid 为形容词
native: As the illustration makes clear,...
safe: The picture vividly shows that...

chinglish: It is not only beneficial for advance of a nation, but also essential for development of a person.
category: C5 搭配错误 + C1 冗余
source: 中国教育在线 2015-12-03 低分陷阱原文例句
issue: beneficial 后接 to 而非 for；advance 应为名词 advancement；development 前缺 the；句式堆砌
native: It benefits both national progress and individual growth.
safe: It is beneficial not only to the development of a nation but also to personal growth.

chinglish: My apartment is convenient to walk to the subway station in 5 minutes.
category: C5 搭配错误
source: 广东教育杂志社《学生习作中的中式英语》2014-12: convenient 搭配应为 it is convenient to do sth.
issue: convenient 不用人/物作主语，应用 it 作形式主语
native: My place is just a five-minute walk from the subway.
safe: It is convenient to walk to the subway station in 5 minutes.
exam_type: 英一/二|小作文（建议/投诉）

chinglish: We need to cost 380 yuan per month for the apartment.
category: C5 搭配错误（cost 主语）
source: 广东教育杂志社 2014-12 原文: cost 的主语一般是物
issue: cost 主语应为物（The apartment costs...），人作主语应用 spend
native: The rent comes to 380 yuan a month.
safe: The apartment costs 380 yuan per month. / We spend 380 yuan per month.
exam_type: 英一/二|小作文（投诉/建议）

chinglish: Dear Teacher Li:
category: C10 语域不当 + 格式错误
source: 研招网 2013-11-15: 称呼应用 "Dear...,"（逗号），不用冒号；新航道 2026-06-09: 不用 "Dear Teacher"
issue: 英语书信称呼后用逗号不用冒号；"Teacher" 不是英语称呼语，应用 Professor/Mr./Ms.
native: Dear Professor Li,
safe: Dear Professor Li,（认识的人用具体职称）/ Dear Sir or Madam,（不认识的人）

chinglish: I am writing this letter to tell you that I want to complain about...
category: C2 名词化 + C1 冗余
source: 新航道 2026-06-09 语域分析；Pinkham (2000) "unnecessary verb + noun" 类型
issue: "write this letter to tell you" 拖沓；投诉信应直接、礼貌、正式
native: I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with...
safe: I am writing to make a complaint about...

chinglish: Please walk slowly and take care on the way home.
category: C4 逐字直译（客套语）
source: 搜狐/领思研学 2026-09-10 第3条: "Please walk slowly" 中文客套语直译，英语读者困惑
issue: 英语中告别不说 walk slowly；应说 Take care / Have a safe trip
native: Take care, and have a safe trip home.
safe: Take care on your way home.
exam_type: 英一/二|小作文（建议/邀请）

chinglish: As we all know, the environment is becoming worse and worse.
category: C8 万能套话 + C1 冗余
source: 新东方考研 2026-08-16: "As we all know" 列为万能句，被系统性降档
issue: 不针对题目信息；"worse and worse" 口语化；开头即被判套模板
native: Environmental degradation has accelerated over the past decade.
safe: It is widely acknowledged that the environment is deteriorating.（安全版仍用常见句式，但删去 "as we all know" 口语套话）

chinglish: Nowadays, more and more people have realized the importance of environmental protection.
category: C8 万能开头 + C2 名词化
source: 勤学教育 2022-02-09 避坑指南: "Nowadays, more and more people..." 列为烂大街模板句；新东方 2026-08-16
issue: 开头三句式之一，阅卷疲劳；无具体信息增量
native: Public awareness of environmental issues has grown steadily.
safe: In recent years, people have come to realize the importance of environmental protection.

chinglish: We should take effective measures to solve this problem.
category: C2 名词化 + C8 套话
source: 跨考教育/研招网 2014-05-15 段落衔接分析；万能结尾句高频出现（豆丁网模板 2014-06）
issue: "take measures" = act；结尾空喊口号，无具体建议；万能结尾降档
native: Policymakers should invest in public transit and enforce stricter emission standards.
safe: We should take effective measures to solve this problem.（安全版保留，但建议补具体措施：如 plant more trees, reduce waste...）

chinglish: It is widely acknowledged that...
category: C8 万能套话
source: 新东方考研 2026-08-16 原文列为万能句首句；勤学教育 2022-02-09 避坑指南
issue: 不传递任何针对话题的信息，纯凑字数；2026阅卷信号：系统性降档
native: Research consistently shows that... / Studies indicate that...
safe: It is widely believed that...（安全版可偶用，但不宜放在首句开头）

chinglish: I very much agree with this opinion.
category: C4 逐字直译 + C9 词性
source: 信阳师范学院学报 2008-04: "I very much love my mother" 为一对一英汉对应典型错误；搜狐 2026-09-10 "I very like it" 第2条
issue: very 不能直接修饰动词 agree；应用 very much 放句末，或用 strongly agree
native: I couldn't agree more with this view.
safe: I strongly agree with this opinion. / I agree with this opinion very much.

chinglish: The number of students who choose to study abroad is increasing rapidly.
category: C2 名词化倾向（可优化）
source: Williams Style Ch.5 "Characters and Actions"：将名词短语转为主动动词更清晰；Cambridge Dictionary 例句对照
issue: 语法正确但偏冗长；母语者更倾向用动词直接表达趋势
native: More students are choosing to study abroad.
safe: An increasing number of students choose to study abroad.（安全版保留，考研范围内可接受）

chinglish: With the rapid development of science and technology, our life has become more and more convenient.
category: C8 万能开头 + C1 冗余
source: 新东方在线 2014-12 六级常用句型（原文例句）；新东方考研 2026-08-16 降档信号
issue: 万能开头+万能结尾组合；无具体信息；2024真题"网络直播"超40%考生用此句开头
native: Digital technology has transformed how we live, work, and communicate.
safe: The development of science and technology has greatly changed our lives.（删去 "rapid"、"more and more"，直入主题）

chinglish: In my opinion, I think this is a very good phenomenon.
category: C1 冗余（同义重复）
source: Pinkham (2000) Ch.1.4 "Saying the Same Thing Twice"；万能结尾/观点句高频错误（示意，基于多源归纳）
issue: "In my opinion" = "I think"，语义重复；"very good" 空洞
native: From my perspective, this trend is largely positive.
safe: I think this is a positive phenomenon.（删去 in my opinion，避免重复）

chinglish: We should protect the environment and make our country become more beautiful.
category: C2 名词化 + C8 口号式结尾
source: Pinkham (2000) Ch.2 "unnecessary verb + noun"；万能结尾"让我们共同努力"类（新东方 2026-08-16 原文批评）
issue: "make our country become" = beautify；结尾空喊口号，无具体建议
native: By reducing waste and using public transit, we can build more sustainable communities.
safe: We should protect the environment and make our country more beautiful.（安全版可保留，但建议补1-2条具体行动）

chinglish: Notice: Everyone should attend the meeting on time. Don't be late.
category: C10 语域不当（通知过于口语）
source: 新东方在线 2025-04-10《考研英语通知作文高分写作技巧》: 通知应用正式语言，避免口语化表达；新东方在线 2025-09-25 格式规范
issue: 通知是正式文体，"Don't be late" 口语化；应用被动/正式表述
native: All attendees are required to be present punctually.
safe: All students are required to attend the meeting on time.（删去 "Don't be late" 口语句）

chinglish: I hope you can consider my suggestion and give me a reply soon.
category: C10 语域（可更礼貌正式）
source: 新航道 2026-06-09: 正式书信应用 "I would appreciate it if you could..."；研招网 2009-08-25 "四化"原则
issue: 给教授/官方机构写信，hope you can 略显随意；正式应用 would appreciate
native: I would greatly appreciate your consideration of this suggestion and look forward to your reply.
safe: I would appreciate it if you could consider my suggestion. I look forward to your reply.（安全版用考研大纲内礼貌句式）
register: 书信（正式：建议/申请/投诉）

chinglish: The cartoon tells us a truth that we should keep persevering.
category: C4 逐字直译 + C5 搭配
source: 中国教育在线 2015-12-03 低分陷阱原文风格（"The picture highlight..." 类）；图画作文首句高频错误（示意，基于多源归纳）
issue: cartoon tells us a truth 为中文"告诉我们一个道理"直译；英语图画描述应用 As is revealed/depicted
native: As is vividly illustrated in the drawing, perseverance is the key to success.
safe: As is shown in the picture, we should keep persevering.（安全版用 As is shown 替换 tells us a truth）

chinglish: There are many people think that money is the most important thing.
category: C7 句式糅杂 / 双谓语
source: 新东方网 2014-09-03 十大写作错误第1条: 两个谓语 take 和 can provide；研招网 2014-05-15 句式糅杂
issue: There are...think 双谓语；应改为 There are many people who think... 或直接 Many people think...
native: Many people believe that wealth is the ultimate measure of success.
safe: Many people think that money is the most important thing.

chinglish: Eating vegetables is good for our health and can make us not get sick.
category: C2 名词化 + C4 直译
source: Pinkham (2000) Ch.2; Williams Style Ch.9 Principle 5 "Change negatives to affirmatives"
issue: "make us not get sick" = keep us healthy；否定式表达拖沓；应改为肯定
native: A diet rich in vegetables strengthens the immune system.
safe: Eating vegetables is good for our health and helps us stay healthy.（否定→肯定，安全版不超纲）

chinglish: The graph shows that the percentage of urban population has increased from 30% to 60%.
category: （规范表达，作为英二图表描述基准对照）
source: 新东方在线 2025-09-25 英二作文指南；英二图表作文常用句型（多源共识）
issue: 本句语法正确，但母语者版可更精炼；作为安全版基准条目收录
native: Urbanization has doubled over the period, with the share of city dwellers rising from 30% to 60%.
safe: The graph shows that the percentage of urban population has increased from 30% to 60%.（安全版保留标准图表描述句式）
